_comment: Credentials are NOT stored in this file. Before running email_server.py, set two environment variables: EMAIL_ADDRESS (the Gmail address to monitor) and EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD (a Google App Password — see README 'Running the server' section for how to generate one). This file only holds non-secret behavior settings.
_tracker_source_note: Added 2026-08-14. The live tracker now lives on a native Google Sheet, not the local 'Invoice Traker.xlsx' file — a local .xlsx cannot support the automation writing to it at the same time a human has it open in Excel (OS-level file lock), which a real accountant does nearly continuously; a Sheet supports true concurrent multi-writer access with no locks at all. Set tracker_source to 'excel' (and it'll use tracker_xlsx_path exactly as before) to fall back to the old local-file behavior if ever needed.
